recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片中有多顆母細胞，核圓或凹陷、染色質細緻並偶見核仁，灰藍色細胞質邊緣排列一圈小空泡（string of pearls），部分拉出偽足；同時可見形態異常的嗜中性球，符合 BPDCN 合併 CMML。
features: Medium to large blasts with round to indented nuclei, fine chromatin and occasional small nucleoli
Moderate grey-blue agranular cytoplasm with small vacuoles lining the cell membrane ('string of pearls')
Cytoplasmic tail-like pseudopodia in some blasts
Neutrophils with hypolobated or clumped nuclei suggestive of dysgranulopoiesis
Mild anisopoikilocytosis of background red cells
describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows medium to large blasts with round to indented nuclei, finely dispersed chromatin, occasional small nucleoli, and moderate grey-blue agranular cytoplasm. Several cells show a rim of small peripheral cytoplasmic vacuoles in a 'string of pearls' arrangement and tail-like pseudopodia. Admixed neutrophils show hypolobated and irregularly clumped nuclei. Findings are consistent with blastic plasmacytoid dendritic cell neoplasm, with background dysgranulopoiesis compatible with concurrent chronic myelomonocytic leukemia.

ddx.vs: Monoblasts and promonocytes may be vacuolated but show fine azurophilic granules, folded nuclei and NSE/lysozyme positivity with CD14/CD11c expression.
Burkitt cells have deeply basophilic cytoplasm with prominent round lipid vacuoles and a mature B-cell phenotype with MYC rearrangement.
Promonocytes have folded nuclei and fine granules and count as blast equivalents in CMML, whereas BPDCN blasts are agranular and CD123+TCF4+TCL1+.
